title: Leap Year
description: Checks leap years with a 4/100 rule that rejects every century year.

data.question: Write a program that reads a year and prints True when it is a leap year, otherwise False.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a year and prints True when it is a leap year, otherwise False.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: A year divisible by 4 prints True unless it is also divisible by 100. There is no 400-year exception.
